data.body: Implementation note: adding archived to the built-in status map also required declaring it lossy in _field_contract.py (archived->Done reverses to closed, like deleted) and adding it to the inbound rebar-status recovery vocabulary in inbound_fields.py beside deleted, so the round-trip contract tests stay exact. bridge fsck keeps its default Done target, so its verdicts are unchanged. File impact updated to the 19 touched paths.
